messages:
olivia_cs: Morning all — kicking off the onboarding for Orca Logistics (pilot). Goals: production-readiness by 30 days. High-level success metrics: median latency <1s for 90% of requests, unit cost target <$0.02/token, SSO + webhook integration. Stakeholders below. @kevin_se can you confirm sandbox infra and runbook availability? @sam_pm can you confirm acceptance criteria?
onboard-bot: Workspace created: https://redwood.app/onboards/orca
kevin_se: We have a dedicated sandbox cluster ready. Need their model choices and expected QPS to size. Can we get API keys provisioned by Mon?
nina-corp: Thanks Olivia! We'll provide model preferences and sample traffic by EOD Tues. SSO is being scoped on our side.
sam_pm: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) end-to-end sample workflow with customer comments, 2) error rate <0.5% at up to 1k QPS in perf test, 3) business sign-off on UX + outputs. I'll own final sign-off.
raj_sre: Quick risk note — set renewal-risk trigger: if >10% of calls have latency >2s after go-live, mark renewal risk 'high'. Recommend weekly risk readout to track.
olivia_cs: Noted. Tentative timeline:
```
Week 0 (now): kickoff, access, baseline metrics
Week 1: SSO + webhooks integration, sample traffic ingest
Week 2: performance testing + quantization recommendations
Week 3: canary rollout to 5% traffic
Week 4: full rollout + org enablement session
Day 30: handoff + success review
```
Assigning owners for each milestone — please ack.
kevin_se: I'll own Week 2 perf and the canary plan. Tagging @raj_sre for infra runbook & monitoring.
raj_sre: Roger. I'll add the runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orca-perf and start a synthetic test plan.
olivia_cs: Enablement plan: 60-min training for their ops + devs and a playback doc/recording. @kevin_se can you prepare quickstart snippets? I'll schedule the session with the customer.
nina-corp: Ops team available Wed afternoon this week. We'd appreciate a short playback doc to share internally.
olivia_cs: I'll produce the playback doc + recording. Owners: Olivia (CS) — overall, Kevin (SE) — infra & quickstart, Sam (PM) — acceptance & biz sign-off, Raj (SRE) — runbook & monitoring.
sam_pm: :thumbsup:
kevin_se: Quickstart snippet: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" https://api.redwood/models/text:generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
``` Feel free to reuse in the playback.
nina-corp: Security question — do you support SCIM for SSO? Our identity team requires it.
olivia_cs: Yes, SCIM is supported. I'll loop in Security if they want a deeper call. @kevin_se please share the SSO config doc.
kevin_se: SSO config doc: https://redwood.docs/sso-setup
raj_sre: For risk capture I'll publish a weekly health dashboard to their stakeholders and recommend nightly synthetic traffic during Week 2 to catch regressions early.
olivia_cs: Actions (owners + due dates):
- Kevin -> quickstart + SSO doc (Mon EOD)
- Nina -> sample traffic + user list (Tues EOD)
- Raj -> runbook + dashboard (Wed)
- Sam -> finalize acceptance criteria doc (Thurs)
I'll set a recurring weekly sync (Tues 9am PT).
nina-corp: Confirmed — Tues 9am PT works for our team.
onboard-bot: New calendar created: "Orca Onboarding (weekly)" — invite sent to participants
olivia_cs: Small ask: capture feedback from the initial enablement with this short form: https://forms.redwood/enablement-feedback
sam_pm: I'll add a success metrics tracker in the shared drive and link it in the calendar invite.
kevin_se: One more infra Q — any PII restrictions we should be mindful of when ingesting sample traffic? Nina?
nina-corp: No PII in sandbox data. For prod we'll use pseudonymization; our security team will share the exact requirements.
olivia_cs: Closing notes: next steps recorded above. Tagging owners again: @kevin_se @raj_sre @sam_pm. See you on Tues. Thanks!
